body:
morgan: Heads-up — hotfix PR 5432 needs 2x LGTM before cutoff in 45m. It's blocking the RC for this sprint. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5432
sam: On it, can reviewers prioritize? I left comments on tests that flaked.
priya: tagging @elaine and @matt — can you take a look? I'll be offline in 30.
elaine: taking a look now, will focus on the assertions.
matt: quick skim — failing case is related to kv-cache TTL change, I can push a follow-up if we need. :thumbsup:
morgan: need approvals that are code-owner-level (infra and runtime). If we can't get 2x by cutoff we fallback to roll-forward tomorrow.
sam: if it's just kv-cache TTL, I can approve after a small test. what's the command to repro locally?
priya: repro:
```
make test-only TESTS=tests/runtime/test_kv_cache.py::test_ttl_edgecase
```
sam: thanks, running now.
sam: tests pass locally, will push ACK and approve in PR if CI is green. :ok_hand: 
elaine: addressed my comment, added a tiny assertion fix.
devops-bot: deploy window closes in 30 minutes (cutoff 1925003034). Reminder sent to eng-releases.
matt: leaving an LGTM, but add a note to monitor latency post-deploy.
morgan: @sam @elaine thanks — once PR shows 2x LGTM and green CI I'll cut the RC. Everyone please add post-deploy monitor runbook to the PR description. :rocket: 
priya: done — runbook link added.
sam: LGTM
elaine: LGTM :eyes: 
morgan: merging now.
